name: Spark Monitor
summary: Task manager: see what your PC is doing and end apps that stopped responding. Ctrl+Shift+Esc opens it.
summary_fr: Gestionnaire des tâches : voir ce que fait votre PC et fermer les applications qui ne répondent plus. Ctrl+Maj+Échap l'ouvre.

optional.PIL.ImageTk: sharper app icons in the Apps tab
optional.systemctl: switching systemd --user services in the Startup tab

needs.system: Linux with /proc and /sys; Plasma 6 for grouping by app and the shortcut
